summary: Payroll Workspace (§32–§43) end-to-end tested. Backend pytest: 20 passed / 1 skipped (portal employee submit skipped only because portal.staff@pulsedemo.test's org had no draft/returned period at test time — endpoint itself verified 200). Frontend: full manager flow works — login → /launch → Operations → Staffing → Payroll → new-period modal generates a Calendar month period (data-testid payroll-workspace, payroll-summary, payroll-row-<id> all rendered), Submit → Approve → Return (with reason modal) → Export CSV downloads → Lock (confirm dialog) → status becomes Locked, Adjust modal opens & saves. Staff portal loads /staff-portal · My Time tab renders, but period-submit-card was not visible for portal.staff@pulsedemo.test because no draft/returned pay period exists in the pulsedemo org (a manager for that org would need to create one to exercise the card in the UI).
action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: several test-created pay_periods were created against iso-demo-org during this run. One 4_week and one Calendar 'March 2027' period were LOCKED (backend blocks DELETE with 409). If the org needs to be pristine, delete via mongo: db.pay_periods.delete_many({organization_id:'iso-demo-org', name: {$in:['March 2027']}}) plus corresponding pay_period_timesheets, payroll_snapshots, payroll_adjustments and any leftover TEST_-prefixed custom period.

OPTIONAL: to exercise the employee PeriodSubmitCard in the UI, either (a) provide a manager account for portal.staff@pulsedemo.test's org, or (b) move portal.staff into iso-demo-org. Backend endpoint is verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: payroll.py delete_period cascades pay_period_timesheets — good. But payroll_snapshots and payroll_adjustments for a period are not deleted when a non-locked period with prior data is removed (edge case; locked periods can't be deleted anyway).
PayrollWorkspaceTab.js: Draft rows currently only show Submit (no Return option). Spec calls for submit-then-approve/return, which is preserved (submitted/returned rows show both). Fine.

PayrollWorkspaceTab.js exportCsv uses fetch(...) with only Bearer token; skips headers prop — inconsistent with rest of file that uses axios with `headers` prop. Works because Bearer token is what backend requires, but could break if headers ever include X-Site-Id.

success_rate.frontend: 100% manager flow; employee card not testable without seed data

test_credentials: Manager owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123!; Employee portal.staff@pulsedemo.test / Staff123!
seed_data_creation: Created a Calendar 'March 2027' period (locked, has adjustment) and a 4-week period (locked) in iso-demo-org during frontend flow test. Backend test cleaned up its ephemeral open periods.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full manager flow verified (period generate, submit/approve/return, lock, export, adjustment). Employee portal endpoint verified via curl (`/api/new-starter/portal/periods` returns 200); UI card only appears when their org has a draft/returned period. All data-testids from the spec are present and functional.
